note: This file contains only string constants (prompt templates) with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. No CLI-invocable code is present.
AGENTLESS_REPAIR: a prompt template string for issue repair tasks, parameterized with {problem_statement} and {content}
CODE_FILE: a prompt template string for code file display, parameterized with {path} and {content}
THINKING_SYSTEM: a system prompt template that instructs the model to output thinking in <thinking> tags before a <solution>
